Also looping Alicia from our ops team — she'll share current rack/vendor constraints.

Subject: Re: On-prem / Air-gapped deployment — hardware & offline ops follow-up

Hi Tom, Alicia —

Following up with the technical details: 

- GPU recommendations: for your expected throughput we recommend a mix of H100 80GB for the 6 primary inferencing hosts and 40GB A100s for batch/embeddings workloads. If budget is constrained, a uniform H100 80GB pool provides the simplest performance profile.
- HA model: active-active is preferred for serving with a front-end load balancer + consistent hashing for KV cache; that gives better failover without manual cutover. We can also support active-passive if you have concerns about cache consistency during failover.
- Storage/network: recommend 4 x 3.84TB NVMe per host for model shards and local cache; 100GbE fabric between hosts; separate management network for orchestration and telemetry.
- Offline update flow (high level): Redwood packages signed artifact bundles (sha256 + vendor signature). You host the bundle on an internal artifact repository (air-gapped transfer via encrypted USB or internal staging server). Our installer runs a local signature verification and writes an update manifest; rollback uses a snapshot-based approach. We provide a validation checklist and runbook for the upgrade window.

Attached: hardware-specs.pdf (detailed bill-of-materials + rack/power guidance).

Next steps: propose a 90-minute technical workshop next Wed (Mar 17) with your infra and security teams to walk the install and patch flow end-to-end. Does 10:00–11:30am ET work for you?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: hardware-specs.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
